cover.headline: See the Whole AI Revenue Funnel, Live

about:
Most B2B companies don't have a lead problem. They have a leak problem. Marketing counts leads, sales counts deals, and nobody owns what happens in between.

Tantra builds the in between: AI revenue systems that take a stranger from first invite to signed client, with one CRM and one weekly number for every stage.

See it working first. {{when_cap}}, our founder Adi runs a live {{minutes}}-minute webinar that takes the whole funnel apart:

→ How to fill a session from a cold list with calendar invites, cold email and LinkedIn
→ The email and WhatsApp reminders that get registrants into the room
→ How 45 minutes becomes booked sales calls
→ The weekly rhythm: one pipeline, one analytics sheet, one experiment log
→ Which parts AI runs, and which still need you

Register with the button at the top of this page.

What we build with your team:
→ Traffic: calendar invites, cold email and LinkedIn, sent from your own accounts
→ Capture: registration and booking pages that feed one CRM
→ Nurture: email and WhatsApp reminders and follow-ups
→ Conversion: a weekly live webinar that ends in booked sales calls
→ Pipeline: every booking, call and proposal tracked to the deal

Our team has built funnels and outreach for 400+ brands in 47+ industries across 21+ countries, over 10+ years.

Two ways to work with us:
→ The Tantra platform: run outreach and nurture from your own accounts. Start at usetantra.com
→ Tantra Enterprise: we build your funnel with you, coach your team for 3 months, and you get a year on the platform

Start with the webinar: https://webinar.sellwithtantra.com

pinned_post.text:
You sent 2,000 invites last month. How many became sales calls?

If you can't answer that with one number, the leak is somewhere between your outreach and your calendar.

{{when_cap}}, our founder Adi takes a working B2B funnel apart, live, in {{minutes}} minutes:

→ How one client's webinar reached 99,859 people, 98,000 of them by calendar invite
→ The reminders we send between sign-up and the live session
→ How 45 minutes turns into booked sales calls
→ Which parts AI runs, and which still need you

Bring your own numbers. You'll leave knowing which stage of your funnel to fix first.

Save your seat: https://webinar.sellwithtantra.com/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=company_page&utm_campaign=enterprise-webinar&utm_content=pinned-post
